sys_remote_update_set.description: Dynamics 365 Contact Center call journey for ServiceNow ITSM (Incidents and ServiceNow users as callers; no CSM needed): Contact Center Call table and fields, call journey card, record button and call picker, recording & transcript pop-up, activity entry, form layouts, related lists, the REST API for the D365 flows, and the softphone: the Dynamics 365 Contact Center Edge desktop in OpenFrame through the page /d365cc_edge.do. After committing, set the d365cc.* system properties, give agents the role sn_openframe_user, open /cache.do once and hard-refresh the agent interface. Version 1.2.0 adds chat and messaging, one incident per chat, resolution code and notes, and fixes the Open call journey link.
sys_remote_update_set.name: D365 Contact Center - Call Journey 1.2.0 (ITSM)

sys_update_xml.payload:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_ui_page"><sys_ui_page action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><category>general</category><client_script/><description>D365 Contact Center recording pop-up (iframe wrapper)</description><direct>false</direct><endpoint/><html><j:jelly trim="false" xmlns:j="jelly:core" xmlns:g="glide" xmlns:j2="null" xmlns:g2="null">
<g:evaluate var="jvar_calls" jelly="true"><![CDATA[
    // Calls come from the database, never from a URL parameter, so this page can only ever frame the
    // Dynamics 365 environment configured in d365cc.org_url.
    var util = new D365CCUtil();
    var list = [];
    var callId = String(RP.getParameterValue('sysparm_call') || '');
    var caseId = String(RP.getParameterValue('sysparm_case') || '');
    var gr = new GlideRecord('u_cc_call');
    if (callId) gr.addQuery('sys_id', callId);
    else if (caseId) gr.addQuery('u_case', caseId);
    else gr.addQuery('sys_id', 'none');
    gr.orderByDesc('u_call_received');
    gr.setLimit(25);
    gr.query();
    while (gr.next()) {
        var url = util.conversationUrl(gr.getValue('u_conversation_id'), true);
        if (!url) continue;
        list.push({ id: gr.getUniqueValue(), title: gr.getValue('u_title') || 'Call', agent: gr.getValue('u_agent') || '', url: url, open: util.conversationUrl(gr.getValue('u_conversation_id'), false) });
    }
    JSON.stringify(list);
]]></g:evaluate>
<style>
    html, body { margin: 0; height: 100%; font-family: "Source Sans Pro", Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; }
    .tabs { position: absolute; top: 0; left: 0; right: 0; height: 44px; display: flex; gap: 8px; align-items: center; padding: 0 12px; border-bottom: 1px solid #d8dde6; background: #fff; overflow-x: auto; }
    .tab { padding: 6px 12px; border: 1px solid #d8dde6; border-radius: 16px; background: #f8f9fb; font-size: 13px; cursor: pointer; white-space: nowrap; }
    .tab.on { background: #1b6ac9; border-color: #1b6ac9; color: #fff; }
    .wrap { position: absolute; left: 0; right: 0; bottom: 40px; background: #f4f6fa; }
    #d365-frame { width: 100%; height: 100%; border: 0; background: #fff; }
    #d365-loading { position: absolute; inset: 0; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; color: #5f6b7a; font-size: 14px; }
    .footer { position: absolute; left: 0; right: 0; bottom: 0; height: 40px; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; padding: 0 16px; border-top: 1px solid #d8dde6; background: #fff; font-size: 13px; }
    .footer a { color: #1b6ac9; text-decoration: none; }
    .btn-response-time, #response_time_icon, .response-time-btn { display: none !important; }
    #d365-loading::before { content: ''; width: 18px; height: 18px; margin-right: 10px; border: 3px solid #d8dde6; border-top-color: #1b6ac9; border-radius: 50%; animation: d365spin 0.8s linear infinite; }
    @keyframes d365spin { to { transform: rotate(360deg); } }
    .msg { padding: 24px; color: #5f6b7a; font-size: 14px; }
</style>
<div id="calls-data" data-calls="${HTML:jvar_calls}" style="display:none"></div>
<div id="tabs" class="tabs" style="display:none"></div>
<div id="wrap" class="wrap" style="top:0">
    <div id="d365-loading">Loading the call from Dynamics 365 Contact Center…</div>
    <iframe id="d365-frame" title="Dynamics 365 Contact Center call" allow="autoplay; clipboard-write; microphone"
            onload="document.getElementById('d365-loading').style.display='none'"></iframe>
</div>
<div class="footer" id="footer">
    <a id="newtab" href="#" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Open in a new tab ↗</a>
    <span style="color:#5f6b7a;">Dynamics 365 Contact Center</span>
</div>
<div id="empty" class="msg" style="display:none">No Dynamics 365 recording is linked yet, or the Dynamics 365 URL is not configured (system property <b>d365cc.org_url</b>).</div>
<script>
    var calls = JSON.parse(document.getElementById('calls-data').getAttribute('data-calls') || '[]');
    function show(i) {
        var c = calls[i];
        document.getElementById('d365-loading').style.display = 'flex';
        document.getElementById('d365-frame').src = c.url;
        document.getElementById('newtab').href = c.open;
        var t = document.querySelectorAll('.tab');
        for (var k = 0; k !== t.length; k++) t[k].className = 'tab' + (k === i ? ' on' : '');
    }
    if (calls.length === 0) {
        document.getElementById('wrap').style.display = 'none';
        document.getElementById('footer').style.display = 'none';
        document.getElementById('empty').style.display = 'block';
    } else {
        if (calls.length !== 1) {
            var bar = document.getElementById('tabs');
            bar.style.display = 'flex';
            document.getElementById('wrap').style.top = '44px';
            for (var n = 0; n !== calls.length; n++) {
                var b = document.createElement('div');
                b.className = 'tab';
                b.textContent = calls[n].title.replace(/^.*? (received|started) on /, '') + (calls[n].agent ? ' · ' + calls[n].agent : '');
                b.setAttribute('data-i', n);
                b.onclick = function () { show(parseInt(this.getAttribute('data-i'), 10)); };
                bar.appendChild(b);
            }
        }
        show(0);
    }
    // Workspace caps its modal at 800x600 (.now-modal-dialog). This page is same-origin with the Workspace, so it
    // lifts that cap and fills the window; harmless when the page is opened outside a Workspace modal.
    function growModal() {
        try {
            var top = window.parent, h = Math.floor(top.innerHeight * 0.94), w = Math.floor(top.innerWidth * 0.96);
            var n = window.frameElement, dialog = null, body = null;
            while (n) {
                var c = n.classList;
                if (c) { if (c.contains('now-modal-dialog')) dialog = n; if (c.contains('now-modal-body')) body = n; }
                n = n.assignedSlot || (n.parentNode ? n.parentNode.host : null) || n.parentElement;
            }
            if (!dialog) return;
            if (!body) return;
            var set = function (el, k, v) { el.style.setProperty(k, v, 'important'); };
            set(dialog, 'max-width', w + 'px'); set(dialog, 'width', w + 'px');
            set(dialog, 'max-height', h + 'px'); set(dialog, 'height', h + 'px');
            var head = h - 90;
            set(body, 'max-height', head + 'px'); set(body, 'height', head + 'px');
            var fe = window.frameElement;
            set(fe, 'width', '100%'); set(fe, 'height', head - 20 + 'px');
            if (fe.parentElement) { set(fe.parentElement, 'width', '100%'); set(fe.parentElement, 'height', head - 20 + 'px'); }
        } catch (e) { }
    }
    growModal();
    setTimeout(growModal, 300);
    setTimeout(growModal, 1200);</script>
</j:jelly>

sys_update_xml.name: sys_script_540d7eca814013107f4492f288a4dd3f
sys_update_xml.payload:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update sys_domain="global" table="sys_script"><sys_script action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><abort_action>false</abort_action><access>package_private</access><action_delete>false</action_delete><action_insert>true</action_insert><action_query>false</action_query><action_update>true</action_update><active>true</active><add_message>false</add_message><advanced>true</advanced><change_fields>false</change_fields><client_callable>false</client_callable><collection>u_cc_call</collection><condition/><description>Adds Contact Center Call created / completed entries (with a link to the call journey) to the Case activity stream.</description><execute_function>false</execute_function><filter_condition/><is_rest>false</is_rest><message/><name>D365CC - Post call to Case activity</name><order>300</order><priority>100</priority><rest_method/><rest_method_text/><rest_service/><rest_service_text/><rest_variables/><role_conditions/><script><![CDATA[(function executeRule(current, previous) {
    // Post the call to the Case's Activity stream (the equivalent of the Salesforce case-feed entry).
    try {
        if (current.u_case.nil()) return;
        var isInsert = current.operation() == 'insert';
        var completed = current.getValue('u_status') == 'Completed' && (isInsert || current.u_status.changes() || current.u_case.changes());

        var util = new D365CCUtil();
        var cs = new GlideRecord('incident');
        if (!cs.get(current.getValue('u_case'))) return;

        var post = function (kind) {
            var marker = 'Contact Center ' + util.noun(current.getValue('u_channel')) + (kind === 'created' ? ' created' : ' completed');
            var seen = new GlideRecord('sys_journal_field');
            seen.addQuery('element_id', cs.getUniqueValue());
            seen.addQuery('element', 'work_notes');
            seen.addQuery('value', 'CONTAINS', marker);
            seen.addQuery('value', 'CONTAINS', current.getUniqueValue());
            seen.setLimit(1);
            seen.query();
            if (seen.next()) return;
            cs.work_notes = util.activityNote(current, kind);
            cs.update();
        };

        // One entry per call: posted when the call completes (an in-progress call has no entry yet).
        if (completed) {
            post('completed');
            // Safety net: write the call summary when the record still has no resolution notes (existing notes are never replaced).
            var rec = new GlideRecord('incident');
            if (rec.get(current.getValue('u_case')) && rec.isValidField('close_notes')) {
                var cur = rec.getValue('close_notes') || '';
                if (!cur) {
                    var noun = util.noun(current.getValue('u_channel'));
                    var secs = parseInt(current.getValue(noun === 'call' ? 'u_talk_time_seconds' : 'u_handle_time_seconds') || '0', 10);
                    var parts = ['Resolved on a Dynamics 365 Contact Center ' + noun + ' (' + (current.getValue('u_title') || noun) + ').'];
                    if (current.getDisplayValue('u_agent')) parts.push('Agent: ' + current.getDisplayValue('u_agent') + '.');
                    if (secs) parts.push((noun === 'call' ? 'Talk time: ' : 'Handle time: ') + Math.floor(secs / 60) + 'm ' + (secs % 60) + 's.');
                    if (current.getDisplayValue('u_customer_sentiment')) parts.push('Customer sentiment: ' + current.getDisplayValue('u_customer_sentiment') + '.');
                    if (current.getValue('u_quality_summary')) parts.push('Summary: ' + current.getValue('u_quality_summary'));
                    rec.setValue('close_notes', parts.join(' '));
                    rec.update();
                }
            }
        }
    } catch (e) {
        gs.error('[D365CC] Could not post call to Case activity: ' + e);
    }
})(current, previous);]]></script><sys_class_name>sys_script</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-10-22 04:17:04</sys_created_on><sys_domain>global</sys_domain><sys_domain_path>/</sys_domain_path><sys_id>540d7eca814013107f4492f288a4dd3f</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>D365CC - Post call to Case activity</sys_name><sys_overrides/><sys_package display_value="Global" source="global">global</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Global">global</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_script_540d7eca814013107f4492f288a4dd3f</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-10-22 04:17:04</sys_updated_on><template/><when>after</when></sys_script><sys_translated_text action="delete_multiple" query="documentkey=540d7eca814013107f4492f288a4dd3f"/></record_update>

sys_update_xml.payload:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_ui_page"><sys_ui_page action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><category>general</category><client_script/><description/><direct>false</direct><endpoint/><html><j:jelly trim="false" xmlns:j="jelly:core" xmlns:g="glide" xmlns:j2="null" xmlns:g2="null">
<g:evaluate var="jvar_calls" jelly="true"><![CDATA[
    var caseId = String(RP.getParameterValue('sysparm_case') || '');
    var list = [];
    if (/^[0-9a-f]{32}$/.test(caseId)) {
        var j = new D365CCJourney();
        var gr = new GlideRecord('u_cc_call');
        gr.addQuery('u_case', caseId);
        gr.orderByDesc('u_call_received');
        gr.setLimit(50);
        gr.query();
        while (gr.next()) {
            var when = '';
            if (gr.getValue('u_call_received')) { var g = new GlideDateTime(); g.setValue(gr.getValue('u_call_received')); when = g.getDisplayValueInternal(); }
            var q = gr.getValue('u_quality_score');
            var band = (q === null || q === '') ? null : j.scoreBand(Number(q));
            list.push({ id: gr.getUniqueValue(), when: when, agent: gr.getValue('u_agent') || '', dur: j.secs(gr.getValue('u_total_duration_seconds')) || '',
                status: gr.getDisplayValue('u_status') || '', dir: gr.getDisplayValue('u_direction') || '', sentiment: gr.getValue('u_customer_sentiment') || '',
                q: q === null ? '' : q, qband: band ? band[0] : '', qcolor: band ? band[1] : '', qbg: band ? band[2] : '' });
        }
    }
    JSON.stringify(list);
]]></g:evaluate>
<style>
    html, body { margin: 0; overflow-x: hidden; font-family: "Source Sans Pro", Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; color: #242424; }
    .btn-response-time { display: none !important; }
    .cc-hint { padding: 4px 16px 12px; font-size: 13px; color: #5f6b7a; }
    .cc-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 110px 80px 80px minmax(120px, 1fr) 80px 100px 110px 100px; align-items: center; column-gap: 12px; padding: 12px 16px; box-sizing: border-box; }
    .cc-head { font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; color: #5f6b7a; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.03em; border-top: 1px solid #e6e9ef; background: #f7f8fa; padding-top: 8px; padding-bottom: 8px; }
    .cc-row { border-top: 1px solid #e6e9ef; cursor: pointer; font-size: 14px; }
    .cc-row:hover { background: #eef4fc; }
    .cc-date { font-weight: 600; }
    .cc-muted { color: #5f6b7a; }
    .cc-pill { display: inline-block; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; padding: 2px 10px; border-radius: 10px; white-space: nowrap; }
</style>
<div class="cc-hint">This case has several calls. Pick one to open it.</div>
<div class="cc-grid cc-head"><div>Date</div><div>Time</div><div>Direction</div><div>Agent</div><div>Duration</div><div>Sentiment</div><div>Quality</div><div>Status</div></div>
<div id="list" data-calls="${HTML:jvar_calls}"></div>
<script>
(function () {
    var calls = JSON.parse(document.getElementById('list').getAttribute('data-calls') || '[]');
    var caseId = (location.search.match(/sysparm_case=([0-9a-f]{32})/) || [])[1] || '';
    var bc = new BroadcastChannel('d365cc_open');
    // Workspace caps its modal at 800x600; this page is same-origin, so widen the dialog to fit the table.
    function growModal() {
        try {
            var top = window.parent, w = Math.min(1100, Math.floor(top.innerWidth * 0.96)), h = Math.min(560, Math.floor(top.innerHeight * 0.9));
            var n = window.frameElement, dialog = null, body = null;
            while (n) {
                var cl = n.classList;
                if (cl) { if (cl.contains('now-modal-dialog')) dialog = n; if (cl.contains('now-modal-body')) body = n; }
                n = n.assignedSlot || (n.parentNode ? n.parentNode.host : null) || n.parentElement;
            }
            if (!dialog || !body) return;
            var set = function (el, k, v) { el.style.setProperty(k, v, 'important'); };
            set(dialog, 'max-width', w + 'px'); set(dialog, 'width', w + 'px'); set(dialog, 'max-height', h + 'px'); set(dialog, 'height', h + 'px');
            var bh = (h - 90) + 'px';
            set(body, 'max-height', bh); set(body, 'height', bh);
            var fe = window.frameElement;
            set(fe, 'width', '100%'); set(fe, 'height', (h - 110) + 'px');
            if (fe.parentElement) { set(fe.parentElement, 'width', '100%'); set(fe.parentElement, 'height', (h - 110) + 'px'); }
        } catch (e) { }
    }
    growModal(); setTimeout(growModal, 300); setTimeout(growModal, 1200);    function closeModal() {
        try {
            var n = window.frameElement;
            while (n) {
                var root = n.getRootNode ? n.getRootNode() : null;
                var b = root && root.querySelector ? root.querySelector('[aria-label="Close dialog"], button[title="Close dialog"]') : null;
                if (b) { b.click(); return; }
                n = n.assignedSlot || (n.parentNode ? n.parentNode.host : null) || n.parentElement;
            }
        } catch (e) { }
    }
    bc.onmessage = function (e) { if (e.data && e.data.ack) closeModal(); };
    var SENT = { positive: ['#107c10', '#e5f3e5'], neutral: ['#424242', '#ececec'], negative: ['#b10e1c', '#fbe9ea'] };
    function pill(text, color, bg) { var s = document.createElement('span'); s.className = 'cc-pill'; s.textContent = text; s.style.color = color; s.style.background = bg; return s; }
    calls.forEach(function (c) {
        var d = document.createElement('div');
        d.className = 'cc-grid cc-row';
        var date = '', time = '';
        var m = (c.when || '').match(/^(\d{4})-(\d{2})-(\d{2}) (\d{2}):(\d{2})/);
        if (m) {
            var dt = new Date(+m[1], +m[2] - 1, +m[3], +m[4], +m[5]);
            date = dt.toLocaleDateString('en-US', { month: 'short', day: 'numeric', year: 'numeric' });
            time = dt.toLocaleTimeString('en-US', { hour: 'numeric', minute: '2-digit' });
        }
        var cells = [date, time, c.dir, c.agent, c.dur];
        cells.forEach(function (t, i) { var e = document.createElement('div'); e.textContent = t; e.className = i === 0 ? 'cc-date' : (i === 3 ? '' : 'cc-muted'); d.appendChild(e); });
        var s = document.createElement('div');
        if (c.sentiment) { var sc = SENT[c.sentiment.toLowerCase()] || SENT.neutral; s.appendChild(pill(c.sentiment, sc[0], sc[1])); }
        d.appendChild(s);
        var q = document.createElement('div');
        if (c.q !== '') q.appendChild(pill(c.q + ' ' + c.qband, c.qcolor, c.qbg));
        d.appendChild(q);
        var st = document.createElement('div');
        if (c.status) st.appendChild(pill(c.status, '#107c10', '#e5f3e5'));
        d.appendChild(st);
        d.onclick = function () { bc.postMessage({ call: c.id, case: caseId, msg: String(Date.now()) }); };
        document.getElementById('list').appendChild(d);
    });
})();
</script>
</j:jelly></html><name>d365cc_calls</name><processing_script/><sys_class_name>sys_ui_page</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-10-22 04:17:45</sys_created_on><sys_id>162df60e814013107f4492f288a4dd5a</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>d365cc_calls</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Global" source="global">global</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Global">global</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_ui_page_162df60e814013107f4492f288a4dd5a</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-10-22 04:17:45</sys_updated_on></sys_ui_page></record_update>

sys_update_xml.payload:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_ui_page"><sys_ui_page action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><category>general</category><client_script/><description/><direct>false</direct><endpoint/><html><j:jelly trim="false" xmlns:j="jelly:core" xmlns:g="glide" xmlns:j2="null" xmlns:g2="null">
<g:evaluate var="jvar_dest" jelly="true"><![CDATA[
    var util = new D365CCUtil();
    var dest = util.mode() === 'itsm' ? '/' : '/now/cwf/agent/home';
    var callId = String(RP.getParameterValue('sysparm_call') || '');
    var caseId = String(RP.getParameterValue('sysparm_case') || '');
    var ok = /^[0-9a-f]{32}$/;
    var fromCase = String(RP.getParameterValue('sysparm_from') || '');
    var param = '', id = '', table = '';
    if (ok.test(callId)) { param = 'sysparm_call'; id = callId; table = 'u_cc_call'; }
    else if (ok.test(caseId)) { param = 'sysparm_case'; id = caseId; table = new D365CCUtil().recordTable(); }
    if (id) {
        var pr = new GlideRecord('sys_user_preference');
        pr.addQuery('user', gs.getUserID());
        pr.addQuery('name', 'd365cc.play');
        pr.query();
        if (!pr.next()) { pr.initialize(); pr.setValue('user', gs.getUserID()); pr.setValue('name', 'd365cc.play'); pr.setValue('type', 'string'); }
        pr.setValue('value', param + '|' + id + '|' + new GlideDateTime().getNumericValue());
        if (pr.isNewRecord()) pr.insert(); else pr.update();
        dest = util.recordPath(table, id);
        if (param === 'sysparm_call' && ok.test(fromCase)) dest = util.recordPath(util.recordTable(), fromCase);
    }
    dest;
]]></g:evaluate>
<script>location.replace('${jvar_dest}');</script>
</j:jelly></html><name>d365cc_play</name><processing_script/><sys_class_name>sys_ui_page</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-10-22 04:17:45</sys_created_on><sys_id>d62df60e814013107f4492f288a4dd88</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>d365cc_play</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Global" source="global">global</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Global">global</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_ui_page_d62df60e814013107f4492f288a4dd88</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-10-22 04:17:45</sys_updated_on></sys_ui_page></record_update>

sys_update_xml.name: sys_script_fffc3eca814013107f4492f288a4dddd
sys_update_xml.payload:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update sys_domain="global" table="sys_script"><sys_script action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><abort_action>false</abort_action><access>package_private</access><action_delete>false</action_delete><action_insert>true</action_insert><action_query>false</action_query><action_update>true</action_update><active>true</active><add_message>false</add_message><advanced>true</advanced><change_fields>false</change_fields><client_callable>false</client_callable><collection>u_cc_call</collection><condition/><description>Fills title, total duration and virtual agent time; inherits the customer from the Case.</description><execute_function>false</execute_function><filter_condition/><is_rest>false</is_rest><message/><name>D365CC - Calculate call fields</name><order>100</order><priority>100</priority><rest_method/><rest_method_text/><rest_service/><rest_service_text/><rest_variables/><role_conditions/><script><![CDATA[(function executeRule(current, previous) {
    var util = new D365CCUtil();
    var received = current.getValue('u_call_received');

    var channel = current.getValue('u_channel');
    if (received && current.u_title.nil()) current.u_title = util.titleFor(received, channel);
    if (received) current.u_call_received_label = util.titleFor(received, channel).replace(/^.*? (received|started) on /, '');
    if (!current.u_conversation_id.nil()) current.u_conversation_id = String(current.getValue('u_conversation_id')).trim();

    // Total duration = ended - received
    var total = util.secondsBetween(received, current.getValue('u_call_ended'));
    current.u_total_duration_seconds = total === '' ? '' : String(total);

    // Virtual agent time = (agent connected - received) - queue wait, never negative
    var toAgent = util.secondsBetween(received, current.getValue('u_agent_connected'));
    var va = '';
    if (toAgent !== '') {
        var wait = parseInt(current.getValue('u_wait_time_seconds') || '0', 10) || 0;
        va = Math.max(0, toAgent - wait);
    }
    current.u_virtual_agent_seconds = va === '' ? '' : String(va);

    // Inherit the customer from the Case when the call has none
    if (current.u_contact.nil() && !current.u_case.nil()) {
        var cs = new GlideRecord('incident');
        if (cs.get(current.getValue('u_case'))) current.u_contact = cs.getValue('caller_id');
    }
})(current, previous);]]></script><sys_class_name>sys_script</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-10-22 04:17:02</sys_created_on><sys_domain>global</sys_domain><sys_domain_path>/</sys_domain_path><sys_id>fffc3eca814013107f4492f288a4dddd</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>D365CC - Calculate call fields</sys_name><sys_overrides/><sys_package display_value="Global" source="global">global</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Global">global</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_script_fffc3eca814013107f4492f288a4dddd</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-10-22 04:17:02</sys_updated_on><template/><when>before</when></sys_script><sys_translated_text action="delete_multiple" query="documentkey=fffc3eca814013107f4492f288a4dddd"/></record_update>

sys_update_xml.name: sys_script_800d3eca814013107f4492f288a4ddea
sys_update_xml.payload:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update sys_domain="global" table="sys_script"><sys_script action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><abort_action>false</abort_action><access>package_private</access><action_delete>false</action_delete><action_insert>true</action_insert><action_query>false</action_query><action_update>true</action_update><active>true</active><add_message>false</add_message><advanced>true</advanced><change_fields>false</change_fields><client_callable>false</client_callable><collection>incident</collection><condition/><description>When the Copilot Studio IVR sets the D365 Conversation ID on a Case, create the matching Contact Center Call.</description><execute_function>false</execute_function><filter_condition/><is_rest>false</is_rest><message/><name>D365CC - Create call from IVR case</name><order>200</order><priority>100</priority><rest_method/><rest_method_text/><rest_service/><rest_service_text/><rest_variables/><role_conditions/><script><![CDATA[(function executeRule(current, previous) {
    // Create the "Contact Center Call" when the IVR stamps a D365 conversation ID on the Case.
    // Wrapped in try/catch so it can never block or roll back Case creation.
    try {
        if (!current.u_d365_conversation_id.changes()) return;
        var convId = String(current.getValue('u_d365_conversation_id') || '').trim();
        if (!convId) return;

        var existing = new GlideRecord('u_cc_call');
        existing.addQuery('u_conversation_id', convId);
        existing.setLimit(1);
        existing.query();
        if (existing.next()) {
            if (existing.u_case.nil()) {
                existing.u_case = current.getUniqueValue();
                existing.update();
            }
            return;
        }

        // A chat that is already in progress and has no Incident yet belongs to this Incident (the Copilot Studio agent created it during the chat).
        var waiting = new GlideRecord('u_cc_call');
        waiting.addNullQuery('u_case');
        waiting.addQuery('u_channel', '!=', 'Voice call');
        waiting.addQuery('sys_created_on', '>=', gs.minutesAgo(180));
        waiting.orderByDesc('sys_created_on');
        waiting.setLimit(1);
        waiting.query();
        if (waiting.next()) {
            waiting.u_case = current.getUniqueValue();
            waiting.update();
            return;
        }

        var util = new D365CCUtil();
        var call = new GlideRecord('u_cc_call');
        call.initialize();
        call.u_conversation_id = convId;
        call.u_case = current.getUniqueValue();
        call.u_contact = current.getValue('caller_id');
        call.u_call_received = current.getValue('sys_created_on');
        call.u_title = util.titleFor(current.getValue('sys_created_on'));
        call.u_channel = 'Voice call';
        call.u_direction = 'Inbound';
        call.u_handled_by_virtual_agent = true;
        call.u_status = 'In progress';
        if (!current.caller_id.nil()) {
            call.u_caller_phone = current.caller_id.mobile_phone.toString() || current.caller_id.phone.toString();
        }
        call.insert();
    } catch (e) {
        gs.error('[D365CC] Could not create call for case ' + current.getValue('number') + ': ' + e);
    }
})(current, previous);]]></script><sys_class_name>sys_script</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-10-22 04:17:03</sys_created_on><sys_domain>global</sys_domain><sys_domain_path>/</sys_domain_path><sys_id>800d3eca814013107f4492f288a4ddea</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>D365CC - Create call from IVR case</sys_name><sys_overrides/><sys_package display_value="Global" source="global">global</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Global">global</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_script_800d3eca814013107f4492f288a4ddea</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-10-22 04:17:03</sys_updated_on><template/><when>after</when></sys_script><sys_translated_text action="delete_multiple" query="documentkey=800d3eca814013107f4492f288a4ddea"/></record_update>

sys_update_xml.payload:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_ui_script"><sys_ui_script action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><active>true</active><description>Hosts the Dynamics 365 Contact Center Edge desktop and answers its postMessage handshake (used by the d365cc_edge page).</description><global>false</global><ignore_in_now_experience>false</ignore_in_now_experience><name>d365cc_edge_host</name><script><![CDATA[(function () {
    var VERSION = 1;
    var root = document.getElementById('d365cc_edge');
    if (!root) return;
    var edgeUrl = root.getAttribute('data-edge-url') || 'https://portal.us.contactcenterai.powerplatform.com/experience/agent';
    var orgUrl = (root.getAttribute('data-org-url') || '').replace(/\/+$/, '');
    var layout = root.getAttribute('data-layout') || 'compact';
    var verbose = root.getAttribute('data-verbose') === 'true';
    var recordUrl = root.getAttribute('data-record-url') || '/now/cwf/agent/record/{table}/{id}';
    var status = document.getElementById('d365cc_status');
    var iframe = null;
    var lockedOrigin = null;
    var heartbeat = null;
    var pending = {};

    function uuid() {
        if (window.crypto) { if (window.crypto.randomUUID) return window.crypto.randomUUID(); }
        return String(Date.now()) + '-' + String(Math.random()).slice(2);
    }
    function setStatus(t) { if (status) status.textContent = t; }
    function post(msg) {
        if (!iframe) return;
        if (!iframe.contentWindow) return;
        var target = lockedOrigin || new URL(iframe.src).origin;
        if (verbose) console.log('[D365CC Edge] ->', target, msg);
        iframe.contentWindow.postMessage(msg, target);
    }
    function envelope(type, extra) {
        var m = { type: type, version: VERSION, callId: uuid(), timestamp: Date.now() };
        for (var k in extra) { if (Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(extra, k)) m[k] = extra[k]; }
        return m;
    }
    function sendInit() {
        post(envelope('d365edge:init', {
            config: { orgUrl: orgUrl, authMode: 'interactive', layout: layout, crmAdapter: 'servicenow', crmCapabilities: ['screenPop'] },
            theme: { mode: 'light', direction: 'ltr' }
        }));
    }
    function request(type, body) {
        return new Promise(function (resolve, reject) {
            var m = envelope(type, body);
            pending[m.callId] = { resolve: resolve, reject: reject, timer: setTimeout(function () {
                delete pending[m.callId];
                reject(new Error(type + ' timed out'));
            }, 10000) };
            post(m);
        });
    }

    // Screen pop: open the matching ServiceNow customer (by phone, e-mail or name) in the Workspace.
    function screenPop(payload) {
        if (!payload) return;
        var type = String(payload.entityType || '').toLowerCase();
        var id = payload.entityId;
        if (!id) return;
        var set = type === 'account' ? 'accounts' : 'contacts';
        var select = type === 'account' ? '?$select=name,telephone1,emailaddress1' : '?$select=fullname,mobilephone,telephone1,emailaddress1';
        request('d365edge:query', { query: 'retrieveRecord', params: { entitySet: set, id: id, options: select } })
            .catch(function () { return {}; })
            .then(function (rec) {
                rec = rec || {};
                var phone = rec.mobilephone || rec.telephone1;
                var name = rec.fullname || rec.name || payload.entityName;
                if (!phone && !rec.emailaddress1 && !name) return;
                // The match runs on the server (page d365cc_find) with the signed-in agent's own access: phone
                // (any format, last digits compared), then e-mail, then name.
                var url = '/d365cc_find.do?type=' + encodeURIComponent(type) + '&phone=' + encodeURIComponent(phone || '') +
                    '&email=' + encodeURIComponent(rec.emailaddress1 || '') + '&name=' + encodeURIComponent(name || '');
                fetch(url, { credentials: 'same-origin' }).then(function (r) { return r.text(); }).then(function (html) {
                    var m = html.match(/id="d365cc_found">([a-z0-9_]+)\|([0-9a-f]{32})</);
                    if (m) openRecord(m[1], m[2]);
                }).catch(function () { });
            });
    }
    var ofReady = false;
    if (window.openFrameAPI) {
        try { window.openFrameAPI.init({}, function () { ofReady = true; }, function () { ofReady = false; }); } catch (e) { }
    }
    function showPanel() {
        if (!ofReady) return;
        try { window.openFrameAPI.show(); } catch (e) { }
    }
    // The panel is shown for every offered conversation. When the browser tab is hidden or minimized, a system
    // notification is raised too (the agent has to allow notifications for this instance once).
    function alertIncoming() {
        try {
            if (!window.Notification) return;
            if (Notification.permission === 'default') { Notification.requestPermission(); return; }
            if (Notification.permission !== 'granted') return;
            var n = new Notification('Incoming call', { body: 'A Dynamics 365 Contact Center conversation is waiting for you.', tag: 'd365cc-incoming', requireInteraction: true });
            n.onclick = function () { try { window.top.focus(); } catch (e) { } showPanel(); n.close(); };
        } catch (e) { }
    }
    function openRecord(table, sysId) {
        if (ofReady) {
            try { window.openFrameAPI.openServiceNowForm({ entity: table, query: 'sys_id=' + sysId }); return; } catch (e) { }
        }
        try { window.top.location.href = recordUrl.replace('{table}', table).replace('{id}', sysId); } catch (e) { }
    }

    window.addEventListener('message', function (e) {
        var d = e.data;
        if (!d) return;
        if (typeof d !== 'object') return;
        if (typeof d.type !== 'string') return;
        if (d.type.indexOf('d365edge:') !== 0) return;
        if (d.version !== VERSION) return;
        if (lockedOrigin === null) {
            if (!iframe) return;
            if (e.source !== iframe.contentWindow) return;
            lockedOrigin = e.origin;
        } else if (e.origin !== lockedOrigin) {
            return;
        }
        if (verbose) console.log('[D365CC Edge] <-', e.origin, d);
        switch (d.type) {
            case 'd365edge:ping': sendInit(); break;
            case 'd365edge:ready':
                setStatus('');
                if (heartbeat) clearInterval(heartbeat);
                heartbeat = setInterval(function () { post(envelope('d365edge:heartbeat', {})); }, 30000);
                break;
            case 'd365edge:heartbeat': post({ type: 'd365edge:heartbeat', version: VERSION, callId: d.callId, timestamp: Date.now() }); break;
            case 'd365edge:event':
                if (d.event === 'conversation.invited') { showPanel(); alertIncoming(); }
                if (d.event === 'screenPop.requested') screenPop(d.data);
                break;
            case 'd365edge:command:response':
            case 'd365edge:query:response':
                var p = pending[d.callId];
                if (!p) break;
                clearTimeout(p.timer);
                delete pending[d.callId];
                if (d.success === false || d.error) p.reject(new Error((d.error && d.error.message) || 'Unknown error'));
                else p.resolve(d.data);
                break;
            case 'd365edge:error': setStatus('Error: ' + ((d.error && d.error.message) || 'unknown')); break;
            default: break;
        }
    });

    if (!orgUrl || orgUrl.indexOf('YOURORG') >= 0) { setStatus('Set the system property d365cc.org_url to your Dynamics 365 URL.'); return; }
    var url = new URL(edgeUrl);
    url.searchParams.set('orgUrl', orgUrl);
    url.searchParams.set('embedded', 'true');
    iframe = document.createElement('iframe');
    iframe.src = url.toString();
    iframe.setAttribute('sandbox', 'allow-scripts allow-same-origin allow-popups allow-forms allow-popups-to-escape-sandbox allow-modals allow-downloads');
    iframe.setAttribute('allow', 'microphone; camera; autoplay; clipboard-read; clipboard-write; display-capture; storage-access');
    iframe.title = 'Dynamics 365 Contact Center';
    root.appendChild(iframe);
    // The portal pings first; send init once on load as well in case the first ping arrived before we listened.
    iframe.addEventListener('load', function () { setTimeout(sendInit, 300); });
})();]]></script><script_name/><sys_class_name>sys_ui_script</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-10-22 04:18:02</sys_created_on><sys_id>123dba0e814013107f4492f288a4dda1</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>d365cc_edge_host</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Global" source="global">global</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Global">global</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_ui_script_123dba0e814013107f4492f288a4dda1</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-10-22 04:18:02</sys_updated_on><ui_type>10</ui_type><use_scoped_format>false</use_scoped_format></sys_ui_script></record_update>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_ui_page"><sys_ui_page action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><category>general</category><client_script/><description>Screen pop lookup used by the Edge host page.</description><direct>false</direct><endpoint/><html><j:jelly trim="false" xmlns:j="jelly:core" xmlns:g="glide" xmlns:j2="null" xmlns:g2="null">
<g:evaluate var="jvar_found" jelly="true"><![CDATA[
    var util = new D365CCUtil();
    var isAccount = String(RP.getParameterValue('type') || '').toLowerCase() === 'account';
    var table = isAccount ? util.prop('account_table', 'customer_account') : util.customerTable();
    var id = '';
    try {
        id = util.findCustomer(String(RP.getParameterValue('name') || ''), String(RP.getParameterValue('email') || ''), String(RP.getParameterValue('phone') || ''), table, isAccount, true);
    } catch (e) { gs.error('[D365CC] screen pop lookup failed: ' + e); }
    id ? table + '|' + id : '';
]]></g:evaluate>
<div id="d365cc_found">${jvar_found}</div>
</j:jelly></html><name>d365cc_find</name><processing_script/><sys_class_name>sys_ui_page</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-10-22 04:18:03</sys_created_on><sys_id>6a3dfa0e814013107f4492f288a4dd49</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>d365cc_find</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Global" source="global">global</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Global">global</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_ui_page_6a3dfa0e814013107f4492f288a4dd49</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-10-22 04:18:03</sys_updated_on></sys_ui_page></record_update>

sys_update_xml.payload:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_ws_operation"><sys_ws_operation action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><active>true</active><consumes>application/json,application/xml,text/xml</consumes><consumes_customized>false</consumes_customized><default_operation_uri/><enforce_acl/><http_method>POST</http_method><name>Upsert call</name><operation_script><![CDATA[(function process(/*RESTAPIRequest*/ request, /*RESTAPIResponse*/ response) {
    // Upsert a Contact Center Call by D365 conversation ID. Sent by the Dynamics 365 sync flow when a call ends.
    var body = request.body.data || {};
    var convId = String(body.conversation_id || '').trim();
    if (!convId) {
        response.setStatus(400);
        return { error: 'conversation_id is required' };
    }

    // Writable columns only; the server computes durations, title and links.
    var FIELDS = [
        'u_status', 'u_channel', 'u_call_received', 'u_agent_connected', 'u_call_ended', 'u_queue', 'u_agent',
        'u_customer_sentiment', 'u_handled_by_virtual_agent', 'u_talk_time_seconds', 'u_wait_time_seconds',
        'u_handle_time_seconds', 'u_called_number', 'u_caller_phone', 'u_quality_score', 'u_quality_plan',
        'u_quality_summary', 'u_quality_action_plan', 'u_quality_evaluated_at'
    ];
    var DATES = { u_call_received: 1, u_agent_connected: 1, u_call_ended: 1, u_quality_evaluated_at: 1 };

    // The record created per call is a Case (CSM mode) or an Incident (ITSM mode); see the d365cc.mode property.
    var util = new D365CCUtil();
    var RECORD = util.recordTable();
    var gr = new GlideRecord('u_cc_call');
    gr.addQuery('u_conversation_id', convId);
    gr.setLimit(1);
    gr.query();

    // Agent accepted a call: make sure it has a Case (the IVR normally creates it, but not for direct calls).
    var wantCase = (body.create_case === true || body.create_case === 'true');
    if (wantCase && !gr.hasNext() && !body.agent_connected) return { skipped: 'not accepted by an agent yet' };
    // Chats do not get an Incident of their own on accept: the Copilot Studio agent creates one during the chat and the chat is attached
    // to it (below, or by the IVR rule when the Incident appears later). Only a chat that ends with no Incident gets one created.
    var chat = !!body.channel && !util.isVoice(body.channel);
    if (chat) wantCase = false;

    function ensureCase() {
        var existingCase = new GlideRecord(RECORD);
        existingCase.addQuery('u_d365_conversation_id', convId);
        existingCase.setLimit(1);
        existingCase.query();
        if (existingCase.next()) return { id: existingCase.getUniqueValue(), created: false };
        var contactId = util.findOrCreateContact(body.contact_name, body.contact_email, body.caller_phone);
        var nc = new GlideRecord(RECORD);
        nc.initialize();
        var voice = util.isVoice(body.channel);
        nc.short_description = (voice ? 'Inbound call' : util.channelName(body.channel)) + (body.contact_name ? ' from ' + body.contact_name : '') + (body.subject ? ' - ' + body.subject : '');
        nc.description = util.prop('record_label', 'Case') + ' created automatically when an agent accepted a Dynamics 365 Contact Center ' + util.noun(body.channel) + '.' +
            (contactId ? '' : '\nCaller: ' + (body.contact_name || 'unknown') + (body.caller_phone ? ', ' + body.caller_phone : '') + (body.contact_email ? ', ' + body.contact_email : ''));
        nc.contact_type = voice ? 'phone' : 'chat';
        if (contactId) nc.setValue(util.customerField(), contactId);
        nc.u_d365_conversation_id = convId;
        return { id: nc.insert(), created: true };
    }

    // The call row can exist before the accept flow runs (a short call is synced when it ends). Give it its Case.
    if (wantCase && gr.next()) {
        if (gr.getValue('u_case')) return { exists: true, conversation_id: convId };
        var late = ensureCase();
        gr.u_case = late.id;
        gr.update();
        return { exists: true, case_linked: String(late.id), case_created: String(late.created ? late.id : ''), conversation_id: convId };
    }
    var caseCreated = '';
    if (wantCase && !gr.hasNext()) {
        var made = ensureCase();
        if (made.created) caseCreated = made.id;
        gr = new GlideRecord('u_cc_call');
        gr.addQuery('u_conversation_id', convId);
        gr.setLimit(1);
        gr.query();
    }
    var created = false;
    if (!gr.next()) {
        gr.initialize();
        gr.u_conversation_id = convId;
        gr.u_channel = 'Voice call';
        gr.u_direction = 'Inbound';
        // If the IVR already created the Case, link it.
        var cs = new GlideRecord(RECORD);
        cs.addQuery('u_d365_conversation_id', convId);
        cs.setLimit(1);
        cs.query();
        if (cs.next()) gr.u_case = cs.getUniqueValue();
        created = true;
    }

    for (var i = 0; i < FIELDS.length; i++) {
        var f = FIELDS[i];
        var key = f.substring(2);
        if (body[key] === undefined || body[key] === null || body[key] === '') continue;
        var v = body[key];
        if (DATES[f]) {
            // ISO 8601 (2026-09-29T13:13:03Z) -> GlideDateTime (UTC)
            v = String(v).replace('T', ' ').replace(/\.\d+/, '').replace(/Z$/, '').replace(/[+-]00:?00$/, '');
        }
        gr.setValue(f, v);
    }

    // D365 is the source of truth for when the call started, so (re)derive the title from it.
    if (body.call_received) gr.u_title = util.titleFor(gr.getValue('u_call_received'), gr.getValue('u_channel'));
    var id = created ? gr.insert() : gr.update();
    if (chat) {
        var row = new GlideRecord('u_cc_call');
        if (row.get(String(id || gr.getUniqueValue())) && row.u_case.nil()) {
            var target = util.findAgentRecord(row.getValue('u_call_received'));
            if (!target && body.status === 'Completed') target = ensureCase().id;
            if (target) { util.attachCall(row, target); caseCreated = ''; }
        }
    }
    return { sys_id: String(id || gr.getUniqueValue()), created: created, case_created: String(caseCreated), conversation_id: convId };
})(request, response);
]]></operation_script><operation_uri>/api/global/d365cc/call</operation_uri><produces>application/json,application/xml,text/xml</produces><produces_customized>false</produces_customized><relative_path>/call</relative_path><request_example/><requires_acl_authorization>false</requires_acl_authorization><requires_authentication>true</requires_authentication><requires_snc_internal_role>true</requires_snc_internal_role><short_description>Create or update a Contact Center Call by conversation_id</short_description><support_trailing_slash>false</support_trailing_slash><sys_class_name>sys_ws_operation</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-10-22 04:17:42</sys_created_on><sys_id>ad2db60e814013107f4492f288a4dde8</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>Upsert call</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Global" source="global">global</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Global">global</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_ws_operation_ad2db60e814013107f4492f288a4dde8</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-10-22 04:17:42</sys_updated_on><web_service_definition display_value="D365 Contact Center">512db60e814013107f4492f288a4dd1d</web_service_definition><web_service_version/></sys_ws_operation></record_update>

sys_update_xml.name: sys_script_fix_fe3dfa0e814013107f4492f288a4dd83
sys_update_xml.payload:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_script_fix"><sys_script_fix action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><before>false</before><description>Optional repair: re-creates the Contact Center Call form layouts, related lists and the softphone. Safe to run more than once.</description><name>D365CC - Post-install configuration</name><record_for_rollback>true</record_for_rollback><script><![CDATA[/*
 * D365CC - Post-install configuration  (optional repair, safe to run any number of times)
 *
 * Everything is already inside the update set, so you do NOT need to run this after installing.
 * Run it only to repair an install (it re-creates the form layout, related lists and softphone) and to give yourself the softphone role. It:
 *   1. checks the d365cc.* system properties are filled in
 *   2. makes sure the Contact Center Call form layouts exist (Journey card on top, no raw JSON in the Service Operations Workspace)
 *   3. adds the "Contact Center Calls" related lists to the Case (or Incident) and the customer (contact or user)
 *   4. creates the Dynamics 365 Contact Center softphone (OpenFrame) and lets you use it
 */
(function () {
    var out = function (m) { gs.print('[D365CC] ' + m); };
    var CALL = 'u_cc_call';
    // CSM installs use Cases and customer contacts; ITSM-only installs use Incidents and users (d365cc.mode).
    var CASE = gs.getProperty('d365cc.record_table', 'sn_customerservice_case');
    var CUSTOMER = gs.getProperty('d365cc.customer_table', 'customer_contact');

    // 1. Settings
    var org = gs.getProperty('d365cc.org_url', '');
    var ready = org && org.indexOf('YOURORG') < 0;
    if (!ready) out('ACTION NEEDED: set system property d365cc.org_url to your Dynamics 365 URL (and d365cc.app_id). The softphone shows a reminder until it is set.');

    // 2. Form layouts: [caption, elements]. The first section has no caption.
    var sections = [
        ['', ['u_journey_html', '.begin_split', 'u_title', 'u_status', 'u_case', 'u_contact', 'u_direction', 'u_channel', 'u_caller_phone', 'u_called_number',
              '.split', 'u_call_received', 'u_agent_connected', 'u_call_ended', 'u_queue', 'u_agent', 'u_customer_sentiment', 'u_handled_by_virtual_agent', '.end_split']],
        ['Call details', ['.begin_split', 'u_total_duration_seconds', 'u_virtual_agent_seconds', 'u_wait_time_seconds',
              '.split', 'u_talk_time_seconds', 'u_handle_time_seconds', 'u_conversation_id', 'u_recording_url', '.end_split']]
    ];
    var views = ['', 'workspace'];
    for (var v = 0; v < views.length; v++) {
        var viewId = '';
        if (views[v]) { var vw = new GlideRecord('sys_ui_view'); if (!vw.get('name', views[v])) continue; viewId = vw.getUniqueValue(); }
        var form = new GlideRecord('sys_ui_form');
        form.addQuery('name', CALL);
        if (viewId) form.addQuery('view', viewId); else form.addEncodedQuery('viewISEMPTY');
        form.query();
        if (!form.next()) { form.initialize(); form.setValue('name', CALL); if (viewId) form.setValue('view', viewId); form.insert(); }
        for (var s = 0; s < sections.length; s++) {
            var sec = new GlideRecord('sys_ui_section');
            sec.addQuery('name', CALL);
            if (sections[s][0]) sec.addQuery('caption', sections[s][0]); else sec.addEncodedQuery('captionISEMPTY');
            if (viewId) sec.addQuery('view', viewId); else sec.addEncodedQuery('viewISEMPTY');
            sec.query();
            if (!sec.next()) { sec.initialize(); sec.setValue('name', CALL); if (sections[s][0]) sec.setValue('caption', sections[s][0]); if (viewId) sec.setValue('view', viewId); sec.insert(); }
            var secId = sec.getUniqueValue();
            var els = sections[s][1];
            for (var e = 0; e < els.length; e++) {
                var el = new GlideRecord('sys_ui_element');
                el.addQuery('sys_ui_section', secId); el.addQuery('element', els[e]); el.query();
                if (!el.next()) { el.initialize(); el.setValue('sys_ui_section', secId); el.setValue('element', els[e]); if (els[e].charAt(0) === '.') el.setValue('type', els[e]); }
                el.setValue('position', e);
                if (el.isNewRecord()) el.insert(); else el.update();
            }
            var fs = new GlideRecord('sys_ui_form_section');
            fs.addQuery('sys_ui_form', form.getUniqueValue()); fs.addQuery('sys_ui_section', secId); fs.query();
            if (!fs.next()) { fs.initialize(); fs.setValue('sys_ui_form', form.getUniqueValue()); fs.setValue('sys_ui_section', secId); }
            fs.setValue('position', s);
            if (fs.isNewRecord()) fs.insert(); else fs.update();
        }
    }
    // The Service Operations Workspace renders a section that ServiceNow generates with EVERY field of the table (the raw evaluation JSON
    // included). Keep only the fields of the layout above in it.
    var layout = [];
    for (var q = 0; q < sections.length; q++) layout = layout.concat(sections[q][1]);
    var gen = new GlideRecord('sys_ui_section');
    gen.addQuery('name', CALL); gen.addQuery('view', 'Default view'); gen.query();
    while (gen.next()) {
        var old = new GlideRecord('sys_ui_element');
        old.addQuery('sys_ui_section', gen.getUniqueValue()); old.query();
        old.deleteMultiple();
        for (var g = 0; g < layout.length; g++) {
            var ne = new GlideRecord('sys_ui_element');
            ne.initialize(); ne.setValue('sys_ui_section', gen.getUniqueValue()); ne.setValue('element', layout[g]); ne.setValue('position', g);
            if (layout[g].charAt(0) === '.') ne.setValue('type', layout[g]);
            ne.insert();
        }
    }
    out('Contact Center Call form layouts are in place.');

    // 3. Related lists (classic UI)
    var lists = [[CASE, 'u_cc_call.u_case'], [CUSTOMER, 'u_cc_call.u_contact']];
    for (var l = 0; l < lists.length; l++) {
        for (var w = 0; w < views.length; w++) {
            var vid = '';
            if (views[w]) { var vv = new GlideRecord('sys_ui_view'); if (!vv.get('name', views[w])) continue; vid = vv.getUniqueValue(); }
            var rl = new GlideRecord('sys_ui_related_list');
            rl.addQuery('name', lists[l][0]);
            if (vid) rl.addQuery('view', vid); else rl.addEncodedQuery('viewISEMPTY');
            rl.query();
            if (!rl.next()) { rl.initialize(); rl.setValue('name', lists[l][0]); if (vid) rl.setValue('view', vid); rl.insert(); }
            var ent = new GlideRecord('sys_ui_related_list_entry');
            ent.addQuery('list_id', rl.getUniqueValue()); ent.addQuery('related_list', lists[l][1]); ent.query();
            if (!ent.next()) {
                var all = new GlideRecord('sys_ui_related_list_entry'); all.addQuery('list_id', rl.getUniqueValue()); all.orderByDesc('position'); all.setLimit(1); all.query();
                var max = all.next() ? parseInt(all.getValue('position') || '0', 10) : 0;
                ent.initialize(); ent.setValue('list_id', rl.getUniqueValue()); ent.setValue('related_list', lists[l][1]); ent.setValue('position', max + 1); ent.insert();
            }
        }
    }
    out('Related lists added to ' + CASE + ' and ' + CUSTOMER + '.');

    // 4. Softphone (OpenFrame): the Dynamics 365 Contact Center Edge desktop through the page /d365cc_edge.do
    if (GlideTableDescriptor.isValid('sn_openframe_configuration')) {
        var of = new GlideRecord('sn_openframe_configuration');
        of.addQuery('name', 'Dynamics 365 Contact Center'); of.query();
        if (!of.next()) { of.initialize(); of.setValue('name', 'Dynamics 365 Contact Center'); }
        of.setValue('title', 'Dynamics 365 Contact Center'); of.setValue('subtitle', 'Voice and messaging'); of.setValue('url', '/d365cc_edge.do');
        of.setValue('width', '480'); of.setValue('height', '700'); of.setValue('order', '100'); of.setValue('active', true); of.setValue('default', true);
        of.setValue('show_presence_indicator', false); of.setValue('collapsed_view_enabled', false); of.setValue('enforce_sandbox_restrictions', false);
        if (of.isNewRecord()) of.insert(); else of.update();
        var role = new GlideRecord('sys_user_role');
        if (role.get('name', 'sn_openframe_user')) {
            var has = new GlideRecord('sys_user_has_role'); has.addQuery('user', gs.getUserID()); has.addQuery('role', role.getUniqueValue()); has.query();
            if (!has.next()) { has.initialize(); has.setValue('user', gs.getUserID()); has.setValue('role', role.getUniqueValue()); has.insert(); }
        }
        out('Softphone configured. Give the role sn_openframe_user to every agent who should see it, then open /cache.do once and hard-refresh the Workspace.');
    } else {
        out('OpenFrame is not available on this instance; skipped the softphone.');
    }
    out('Done.');
})();]]></script><sys_class_name>sys_script_fix</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-10-22 04:18:03</sys_created_on><sys_id>fe3dfa0e814013107f4492f288a4dd83</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>D365CC - Post-install configuration</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Global" source="global">global</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Global">global</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_script_fix_fe3dfa0e814013107f4492f288a4dd83</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-10-22 04:18:03</sys_updated_on><unloadable>false</unloadable></sys_script_fix></record_update>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_script_include"><sys_script_include action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><access>public</access><active>true</active><api_name>global.D365CCPlay</api_name><caller_access/><client_callable>true</client_callable><description>One-time hand-off that lets journey-card buttons open the recording modal.</description><mobile_callable>false</mobile_callable><name>D365CCPlay</name><sandbox_callable>false</sandbox_callable><script><![CDATA[var D365CCPlay = Class.create();
D365CCPlay.prototype = Object.extendsObject(global.AbstractAjaxProcessor, {
    take: function () {
        var pr = new GlideRecord('sys_user_preference');
        pr.addQuery('user', gs.getUserID());
        pr.addQuery('name', 'd365cc.play');
        pr.query();
        if (!pr.next()) return '';
        var raw = pr.getValue('value') || '';
        pr.deleteRecord();
        if (!raw) return '';
        var p = raw.split('|');
        if (p.length !== 3 || (new GlideDateTime().getNumericValue() - parseInt(p[2], 10)) > 120000) return '';
        return p[0] + '|' + p[1];
    },
    latestCall: function () {
        var gr = new GlideRecord('u_cc_call');
        gr.addQuery('u_case', this.getParameter('sysparm_case'));
        gr.orderByDesc('u_call_received');
        gr.setLimit(1);
        gr.query();
        return gr.next() ? gr.getUniqueValue() : '';
    },
    calls: function () {
        var gr = new GlideAggregate('u_cc_call');
        gr.addQuery('u_case', this.getParameter('sysparm_case'));
        gr.addAggregate('COUNT');
        gr.query();
        var n = gr.next() ? parseInt(gr.getAggregate('COUNT'), 10) : 0;
        return n + '|' + this.latestCall();
    },
    type: 'D365CCPlay'
});]]></script><sys_class_name>sys_script_include</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-10-22 04:17:45</sys_created_on><sys_id>522df60e814013107f4492f288a4dd51</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>D365CCPlay</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Global" source="global">global</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Global">global</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_script_include_522df60e814013107f4492f288a4dd51</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-10-22 04:17:45</sys_updated_on></sys_script_include></record_update>

sys_update_xml.payload:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_ui_page"><sys_ui_page action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><category>general</category><client_script/><description/><direct>false</direct><endpoint/><html><j:jelly trim="false" xmlns:j="jelly:core" xmlns:g="glide" xmlns:j2="null" xmlns:g2="null">
<g:evaluate var="jvar_id" jelly="true"><![CDATA[
    var id = String(RP.getParameterValue('sysparm_call') || '');
    /^[0-9a-f]{32}$/.test(id) ? id : '';
]]></g:evaluate>
<g:evaluate var="jvar_case" jelly="true"><![CDATA[
    var cs = '';
    var cid = String(RP.getParameterValue('sysparm_call') || '');
    if (/^[0-9a-f]{32}$/.test(cid)) { var g = new GlideRecord('u_cc_call'); if (g.get(cid)) cs = String(g.getValue('u_case') || ''); }
    cs;
]]></g:evaluate>
<g:evaluate var="jvar_path" jelly="true">new D365CCUtil().recordPath('u_cc_call', String(RP.getParameterValue('sysparm_call') || '').replace(/[^0-9a-f]/g, ''));</g:evaluate>
<div id="msg" style="font-family:'Source Sans Pro',Helvetica,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:14px;color:#424242;padding:24px;">Opening journey...</div>
<div id="callid" data-id="${jvar_id}" data-path="${jvar_path}" data-case="${jvar_case}" style="display:none"></div>
<script>
(function () {
    var id = document.getElementById('callid').getAttribute('data-id');
    if (!id) { return; }
    var done = false;
    var bc = new BroadcastChannel('d365cc_open');
    bc.onmessage = function (e) {
        if (e.data) { if (e.data.ack === id) { done = true; window.close(); document.getElementById('msg').textContent = 'Opened. You can close this tab.'; } }
    };
    bc.postMessage({ call: id, case: document.getElementById('callid').getAttribute('data-case') || '', msg: String(Date.now()) });
    setTimeout(function () {
        if (!done) { location.replace(document.getElementById('callid').getAttribute('data-path')); }
    }, 1800);
})();
</script>
</j:jelly></html><name>d365cc_open</name><processing_script/><sys_class_name>sys_ui_page</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-10-22 04:17:46</sys_created_on><sys_id>ee2df60e814013107f4492f288a4ddbf</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>d365cc_open</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Global" source="global">global</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Global">global</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_ui_page_ee2df60e814013107f4492f288a4ddbf</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-10-22 04:17:46</sys_updated_on></sys_ui_page></record_update>

sys_update_xml.payload:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update sys_domain="global" table="sys_script"><sys_script action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><abort_action>false</abort_action><access>package_private</access><action_delete>false</action_delete><action_insert>true</action_insert><action_query>false</action_query><action_update>true</action_update><active>true</active><add_message>false</add_message><advanced>true</advanced><change_fields>false</change_fields><client_callable>false</client_callable><collection>sys_properties</collection><condition/><description>Classic widget only: when d365cc.org_url changes, point the classic Dynamics 365 softphone URL at it. The Edge host page needs nothing.</description><execute_function>false</execute_function><filter_condition table="sys_properties">name=d365cc.org_url^EQ<item endquery="false" field="name" goto="false" newquery="false" operator="=" or="false" value="d365cc.org_url"/><item endquery="true" field="" goto="false" newquery="false" operator="=" or="false" value=""/></filter_condition><is_rest>false</is_rest><message/><name>D365CC - Update softphone URL</name><order>100</order><priority>100</priority><rest_method/><rest_method_text/><rest_service/><rest_service_text/><rest_variables/><role_conditions/><script><![CDATA[(function executeRule(current, previous) {
    // Classic widget only: keeps its URL pointed at the Dynamics 365 environment set in d365cc.org_url.
    // The Edge host page (/d365cc_edge.do) reads d365cc.org_url itself, so it needs no update.
    try {
        var of = new GlideRecord('sn_openframe_configuration');
        if (!of.get('name', 'Dynamics 365 Contact Center')) return;
        var url = of.getValue('url') || '';
        if (!url || url.indexOf('dynamicsUrl=') < 0) return;
        var base = url.indexOf('?') > 0 ? url.substring(0, url.indexOf('?')) : 'https://ccaas-embed-prod.azureedge.net/widget/index.html';
        of.setValue('url', base + '?dynamicsUrl=' + String(current.getValue('value') || '').replace(/\/$/, ''));
        of.update();
    } catch (e) {
        gs.error('[D365CC] Could not update the softphone URL: ' + e);
    }
})(current, previous);]]></script><sys_class_name>sys_script</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-10-22 04:17:40</sys_created_on><sys_domain>global</sys_domain><sys_domain_path>/</sys_domain_path><sys_id>012d760e814013107f4492f288a4ddfc</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>D365CC - Update softphone URL</sys_name><sys_overrides/><sys_package display_value="Global" source="global">global</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Global">global</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_script_012d760e814013107f4492f288a4ddfc</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-10-22 04:17:40</sys_updated_on><template/><when>after</when></sys_script><sys_translated_text action="delete_multiple" query="documentkey=012d760e814013107f4492f288a4ddfc"/></record_update>

sys_update_xml.name: sys_script_7fe3e682032c25a7b28bf4a19f29611f
sys_update_xml.payload:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update sys_domain="global" table="sys_script"><sys_script action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><abort_action>false</abort_action><access>package_private</access><action_delete>false</action_delete><action_insert>true</action_insert><action_query>false</action_query><action_update>true</action_update><active>true</active><add_message>false</add_message><advanced>true</advanced><change_fields>false</change_fields><client_callable>false</client_callable><collection>incident</collection><condition/><description>Sets the Resolution code and Resolution notes on records that come from a Contact Center call, when they are created.</description><execute_function>false</execute_function><filter_condition/><is_rest>false</is_rest><message/><name>D365CC - Fill resolution fields</name><order>150</order><priority>100</priority><rest_method/><rest_method_text/><rest_service/><rest_service_text/><rest_variables/><role_conditions/><script><![CDATA[(function executeRule(current, previous) {
    // Records from Dynamics 365 Contact Center always carry a resolution code and resolution notes, plus a caller, assignment group and service, filled once when the record is created
    // (and by this rule on any later update if they are still empty). Anything an agent typed is never replaced.
    try {
        if (current.u_d365_conversation_id.nil()) return;
        var util = new D365CCUtil();
        var codeField = current.isValidField('close_code') ? 'close_code' : (current.isValidField('resolution_code') ? 'resolution_code' : '');
        if (codeField && !current.getValue(codeField)) {
            var ch = new GlideRecord('sys_choice');
            ch.addQuery('name', current.getTableName());
            ch.addQuery('element', codeField);
            ch.addQuery('value', 'Solution provided');
            ch.addQuery('inactive', false);
            ch.setLimit(1);
            ch.query();
            if (ch.hasNext()) current.setValue(codeField, 'Solution provided');
        }
        util.triage(current);
        if (current.isValidField('close_notes') && !current.getValue('close_notes')) {
            var call = new GlideRecord('u_cc_call');
            call.addQuery('u_case', current.getUniqueValue());
            call.orderByDesc('sys_created_on');
            call.setLimit(1);
            call.query();
            var hasCall = call.next();
            var channel = hasCall ? call.getValue('u_channel') : (current.getValue('contact_type') === 'chat' ? 'Live chat' : 'Voice call');
            var noun = util.noun(channel);
            var who = current.isValidField(util.customerField()) ? current.getElement(util.customerField()).getDisplayValue() : '';
            var text = 'Handled on a Dynamics 365 Contact Center ' + noun + (who ? ' with ' + who : '') + '.';
            if (hasCall && call.getValue('u_status') === 'Completed') {
                var secs = parseInt(call.getValue(util.isVoice(channel) ? 'u_talk_time_seconds' : 'u_handle_time_seconds') || '0', 10);
                if (call.getDisplayValue('u_agent')) text += ' Agent: ' + call.getDisplayValue('u_agent') + '.';
                if (secs) text += (util.isVoice(channel) ? ' Talk time: ' : ' Handle time: ') + Math.floor(secs / 60) + 'm ' + (secs % 60) + 's.';
                if (call.getDisplayValue('u_customer_sentiment')) text += ' Customer sentiment: ' + call.getDisplayValue('u_customer_sentiment') + '.';
                if (call.getValue('u_quality_summary')) text += ' Summary: ' + call.getValue('u_quality_summary');
            } else {
                text += ' The call journey, recording and transcript are linked in the Activity.';
            }
            current.setValue('close_notes', text);
        }
    } catch (e) {
        gs.error('[D365CC] Could not fill resolution fields: ' + e);
    }
})(current, previous);]]></script><sys_class_name>sys_script</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-10-22 04:17:04</sys_created_on><sys_domain>global</sys_domain><sys_domain_path>/</sys_domain_path><sys_id>7fe3e682032c25a7b28bf4a19f29611f</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>D365CC - Fill resolution fields</sys_name><sys_overrides/><sys_package display_value="Global" source="global">global</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Global">global</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_script_7fe3e682032c25a7b28bf4a19f29611f</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-10-22 04:17:04</sys_updated_on><template/><when>before</when></sys_script><sys_translated_text action="delete_multiple" query="documentkey=7fe3e682032c25a7b28bf4a19f29611f"/></record_update>
